# Privacy Filter Online

> A free, in-browser privacy remover that detects PII (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, account numbers, dates, URLs, and secrets) and redacts it in one click. Powered by openai/privacy-filter running locally via Transformers.js — your text never leaves the device.

## Core Features

- 100% local inference — no servers, no uploads, no tracking
- WebGPU accelerated, with WebAssembly fallback for older browsers
- 8 PII categories detected at token level via BIOES tagging: names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, account numbers, dates, URLs, and secrets
- Image OCR + PII detection — scan screenshots with on-device Tesseract OCR, then mask sensitive regions
- Multilingual UI — English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, Español, Deutsch, Français, Русский, Português (BR), العربية, 한국어
- Static site — deploys anywhere (Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages)

## Use Cases

- AI prompt sanitization — privacy clean text before pasting into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini
- Log & ticket redaction — strip customer data from bug reports before sharing
- Safe document sharing — mask names, addresses, and account numbers in screenshots
- Secret auditing — catch API keys accidentally committed to docs or chat threads

## Tech Stack

- Framework: Astro 5
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4
- ML runtime: @huggingface/transformers (Transformers.js)
- Model: openai/privacy-filter
- OCR: tesseract.js
- Deployment: Cloudflare Workers / static hosting

## Links

- Live site: https://privacyfilter.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/becoolme/privacyfilter.app
- Model: https://huggingface.co/openai/privacy-filter
- Transformers.js: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
- Blog: https://privacyfilter.app/blog/

## API

This is a client-side only application. There is no server-side API. All inference runs in the browser using Transformers.js. The openai/privacy-filter model is downloaded from Hugging Face on first use and cached locally.
